description: Generic MCP host config for Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, and other clients that launch the Rust rmcp-backed stdio server.
notes: Use the built axiograph binary on PATH, or replace command with an absolute path.
The canonical generated contract is `axiograph authoring integration-manifest`.
The MCP server is read-only; generated files are materialized only through explicit CLI commands.
The host launches Axiograph over MCP stdio; framing, lifecycle, tool listing, and tool calls are handled by the rmcp-backed server.
This launcher is not a custom JSON-RPC protocol specification.
